name: us.iloveferry/bahamas-ferry
title: I Love Ferry · Bahamas Ferry
description: Live Bahamas ferry schedules, prices and booking links: Fort Lauderdale to Bimini and Freeport.

tools.name: get_route_info
tools.description: Everything about the Fort Lauderdale ↔ Bimini and Fort Lauderdale ↔ Freeport ferries sold by I Love Ferry: ports, ships, schedule range, trip types, passenger ages, pets, sales cut-off and how prices and booking work.

tools.name: get_travel_info
tools.description: I Love Ferry's official traveller information for this ferry: passports and documents (US citizens, green card holders, other nationalities, minors, one-way rule), Port Everglades Terminal 21, check-in times and parking, Economy vs Premium seats, change and cancellation rules, luggage allowance and fees, pets, children, accessibility, pregnancy, onboard services, getting around Bimini and ferry + hotel packages.

tools.name: get_ferry_departures
tools.description: Sailing dates and departure times for one direction (e.g. Fort Lauderdale → Bimini) over up to 62 days. No prices. Use it to find days with sailings, and same-day sailings in both directions for a day trip.

origin.description: Port: Fort Lauderdale, Bimini or Freeport (e.g. Fort Lauderdale).

destination.description: Port: Fort Lauderdale, Bimini or Freeport (e.g. Bimini).

from_date.description: First date YYYY-MM-DD (default: first bookable date).

tools.name: search_ferry_prices
tools.description: Live sailings, fares and FINAL TOTAL prices in USD (fares, taxes and Service Fee for all passengers) for a day trip, round trip or one way. Returns ready-to-quote options sorted by price.

origin.description: Port: Fort Lauderdale, Bimini or Freeport (e.g. Fort Lauderdale).

destination.description: Port: Fort Lauderdale, Bimini or Freeport (e.g. Bimini).

trip_type.description: day_trip = back the same day; round_trip needs return_date; one_way = no return.

children_ages.description: Age of each child under 13 (0-2 = infant).

language.description: Language of the conversation; links open the website in this language.

tools.name: create_booking_link
tools.description: Checks the chosen sailing(s) and fare(s) live and returns the final total price and booking_url, which opens iloveferry.us on the booking page with that selection made so the user only enters passenger details and pays. Use the same search values as search_ferry_prices.

origin.description: Port: Fort Lauderdale, Bimini or Freeport (e.g. Fort Lauderdale).

destination.description: Port: Fort Lauderdale, Bimini or Freeport (e.g. Bimini).

trip_type.description: day_trip = back the same day; round_trip needs return_date; one_way = no return.

children_ages.description: Age of each child under 13 (0-2 = infant).

language.description: Language of the conversation; links open the website in this language.

outward.description: Chosen outward sailing and fare, exactly as returned by search_ferry_prices.

flex_code.description: Flexibility code of the chosen fare (the same fare and accommodation can come with different change/cancellation conditions).

return.description: Chosen return sailing and fare, exactly as returned by search_ferry_prices.
